google_login.flow: Mocked Google Auth modal with account avatar switcher (e.g., 'Budi Santoso', 'Siti Rahma', 'Demo User'), preserving isolated data per user.
google_login.visual: Clean OAuth badge with Google G logo, immediate theme hydration based on active user's saved theme.

transaction_entry.flow: Quick modal or drawer with Tabs: [Pengeluaran (Expense)] | [Pemasukan (Income)]. Field for Amount (Rp format input), Category dropdown (with default + 'Tambah Kategori Baru' option), Date picker (Shadcn Popover + Calendar), Description & Payment Method (Cash, Bank, E-Wallet).
transaction_entry.instant_feedback: Sonner toast message upon transaction record addition/deletion.

categories.custom_categories: Users can create custom categories with color code, type (income/expense), and icon picker.

chart_types: Area / Line Chart: Income vs Expense Cashflow trend
Pie / Donut Chart: Expense Breakdown by Category
Summary KPI Stats: Total Pemasukan, Total Pengeluaran, Saldo Bersih, Hemat Rate (%)

formats: PDF Report (styled print layout with logo & chart summary)
export_reports.action_trigger: Dedicated 'Ekspor Laporan' button with format dropdown in the Analytics header.

user_theme_personalization.controls: Theme personalization panel in user profile settings allows picking accent colors (Blue, Green, Red, Midnight), toggle Light/Dark mode, and save preferences linked to active logged-in account.

testing_attributes.convention: kebab-case data-testid attributes on key interactive components

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow JavaScript React conventions (.js files, no TS type assertions).
Ensure monetary values are formatted with Indonesian Rupiah style (e.g. 'Rp 1.500.000').
DO NOT use a plain white or transparent header without blur; use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 or bg-slate-900/80.
Implement Sonner toasts for all add, edit, delete, export, and account switch events.
Provide rich realistic default data for Indonesian context (Gaji, Warung/Supermarket, Listrik PLN, Pulsa, Transportasi) across multiple dates so charts look detailed immediately.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, and cards carry explicit `data-testid` attributes as listed in testing_attributes.
Include local storage / user-state persistence so changing active account or theme updates UI dynamically.
